response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced hands-on engineer (15+ years) with strong backend, distributed-systems and low-latency exposure (Sociomantic/dunnhumby micro-services at millions of req/s) and an entrepreneurial open-source track record. However, the role is an executive CTO position and the resume shows no evidence of executive or people leadership: no team scaling from 10 to 30+, no senior leadership layer development, no board-level communication, and no experience governing outsourced delivery partners. Agentic-AI exposure is recent and tooling-oriented (MCP code generators, agent frameworks) rather than production multi-agent systems operating in high-stakes environments, and fintech exposure is limited to a product engineering role at RIDE Capital without credit-risk, liquidity, or regulatory-compliance architecture ownership. Strong senior/staff IC candidate, but a significant mismatch for this CTO mandate.
strengths: Deep backend/distributed-systems and low-latency experience at high request volumes
Early hands-on exposure to agentic AI infrastructure, MCP, and developer tooling
Founder of an event-driven, Kubernetes-deployed platform plus strong testing/craftsmanship culture
concerns: No executive or engineering-management experience; never scaled or led a team
No production multi-agent AI systems in regulated or high-stakes commercial settings
Limited fintech depth — no credit risk, liquidity, or multi-jurisdiction compliance work

key_factors.factor: Absence of engineering leadership / team scaling
Limited production agentic-AI and ML/LLM evaluation experience
Strong distributed-systems and low-latency backend depth
